sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "country"."Languages" AS g, AVG("roller_coaster"."Speed") AS m1, AVG((CAST("roller_coaster"."Length" AS REAL) / "roller_coaster"."Height")) AS m2 FROM "roller_coaster" JOIN "country" ON "country"."Country_ID" = "roller_coaster"."Country_ID" GROUP BY "country"."Languages"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v"
quantities: roller_coaster.track length relative to coaster height
why: average of top speed per country.Languages
track length / coaster height: a ratio of two quantities in m
average of track length relative to coaster height per country.Languages
gap to the all average of average of track length relative to coaster height (all level)
